fr_html: Tout membre de la Cour doit, avant d'entrer en fonction, en séance publique prendre engagement solennel d'exercer ses attributions en pleine impartialité et en toute conscience.
en_html: Every member of the Court shall, before taking up his duties, make a solemn declaration in open Court that he will exercise his powers impartially and conscientiously.
